description: This file defines the Run class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing a segment of styled rich text with font attributes.

classes.name: Run
classes.description: Represents a segment of styled text with font attributes within a rich text element.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Run class with optional text.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font object associated with this text segment.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font object for this text segment.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the Run object, based on its text and font.
